column1: # Every row here is one systematic UniMorph hin defect: for a subset
# of lemmas it forms the perfective participle and the vowel-initial
# subjunctive/imperative endings with an independent vowel spliced
# onto the consonant stem (बनऊं, बनया, बनइए) instead of the matra the
# grammar requires (बनूं, बना, बनिए). kaikki.org spells them
# correctly, so every disagreement is ruled o1 (first oracle = kaikki).
